Book questions

What this book is for

Answered from the same facts the shelf shows, nothing more.

Who is Quantitative Aptitude for?

Arithmetic chapter by chapter - percentage, profit and loss, time and work - with worked examples.

What does Quantitative Aptitude cover?

The standard reference for arithmetic and elementary mathematics, with theory, solved examples and a large graded exercise set per chapter.

Which exams is Quantitative Aptitude useful for?

Punjab Police, PSSSB, Staff Selection Commission, Banking Exams, Railway Recruitment, Union Public Service Commission, Central Armed Police Forces, General competitive.
